method: Independent AI semantic review of every supplied shuffled item under the frozen policy and rubric. Returned-decision support judged separately from frozen-reference-fact coverage. Fact indices partitioned once each. Fuller frozen criteria retained and ambiguities flagged. No arm inference or unblinding. Grades SHA256 sealed after writing.
aiLimitations: AI semantic judgment is not human adjudication or ground truth. Repetition can reveal pairing but no arm information was inspected. No claim of training-data exclusion.
